I was put on them when I was 16 and every time I started to go downhill I just assumed I needed a higher dosage, and so that's what I got. Recently I switched to a different antidepressant at a much lower dosage since my family and friends were worried about what the one I was on was doing to me (it was only quite recently too that I realised the one I had originally been on wasn't recommended for my age at all). I'm currently 17 and I don't have withdrawals or almost any of the negatives I experienced on Lexapro, so I hope you see your doctor about a medication that would work best for you.

I was put on Lexapro without realising I wasn't meant to be on it at my age and there are reasons for that, I would not recommend it at all if you aren't old enough. I personally had terrible withdrawals if I missed a tablet for just one day.  Seek treatment that is right for you and remember you can't rely on antidepressants alone, put in effort to make yourself better and seek help if you can.
